tool_result_transport.content: one concise text summary for the calling Agent
tool_result_transport.structuredContent: one acs-mcp-result/2 success or problem envelope
tool_result_transport.isError: false for accepted observations and state transitions; true for rejected or failed tool execution

setup_collaboration.title: Set up collaboration
setup_collaboration.description: Set up or revise an explicit collaboration plan containing Scope, AgentSlot, role, Grant, Policy and budget bindings. Returns the accepted collaboration handle and revision.
setup_collaboration.selection_guidance: Use when an Agent has already decided the collaboration topology and needs ACS to authorize and persist it.

find_harnesses.title: Find eligible Harnesses
find_harnesses.description: Find current Harness capacities eligible for a Scope, role and capability set. Returns bounded Machine, Node, Driver, Harness, direction, readiness, evidence and expiry metadata.
find_harnesses.selection_guidance: Use before assigning work to discover capacities supported by current observations.

send_message.title: Send collaboration message
send_message.description: Commit one collaboration Message, its delivery intent, response expectation and completion notification. Returns delivery state, the stable response handle and executable follow-up calls. Async is the default; sync adds one bounded observation of the same response handle.
send_message.selection_guidance: Use for delegation, review requests, handoffs and other addressed collaboration work.

wait_for_response.title: Wait for response
wait_for_response.description: Wait for one or more existing response handles until any or all reach a named receipt or terminal condition, bounded by the supplied timeout. Returns satisfied, pending and terminal handles while durable tracking and completion notification continue.
wait_for_response.selection_guidance: Use when the calling Agent chooses to pause for responses that send_message is already tracking.

read_resource.title: Read collaboration resource
read_resource.description: Read one authorized typed handle for a collaboration plan, Message, response, WorkItem, Evidence or Artifact. Returns bounded metadata, relations, content or content reference, evidence handles and continuation state.
read_resource.selection_guidance: Use the exact handle and view returned by another ACS tool or Inbox item.

check_inbox.title: Check AgentSlot Inbox
check_inbox.description: Check durable Messages and completion notifications addressed to the authenticated AgentSlot. Returns stable handles, delivery state, completion revision and executable read_resource calls.
check_inbox.selection_guidance: Use at startup, reconnect or recovery to resume collaboration from the durable AgentSlot Inbox.

set_notification.title: Set response notification
set_notification.description: Enable or disable automatic completion notification for an existing response handle using an expected subscription revision. Returns the updated subscription state while preserving response tracking.
set_notification.selection_guidance: Use only to change the automatic notification created by send_message.

cancel_work.title: Cancel collaboration work
cancel_work.description: Cancel one WorkItem at its expected revision and record the authorized reason. Returns WorkItem state and any Runtime Attempts that still require observation or separate control.
cancel_work.selection_guidance: Use to end the durable collaboration work objective represented by a WorkItem.

stop_attempt.title: Stop Runtime Attempt
stop_attempt.description: Stop one concrete Runtime Attempt at its expected revision and report the Driver acknowledgement boundary. Returns Attempt state and effect uncertainty requiring readback.
stop_attempt.selection_guidance: Use for a specific execution attempt after its owning WorkItem policy authorizes attempt-level control.

submit_command.title: Submit Domain command
submit_command.description: Submit one fully formed authenticated Domain SurfaceCommand. Returns the canonical Domain disposition and references used by operator, migration, conformance and advanced automation flows.
submit_command.selection_guidance: Use when the caller owns the complete versioned Domain command contract; ordinary Agent collaboration uses the typed tools.
